# Actions of graph `example_graph`

Ontology `staff` 1.0.0. The live source is `graph describe actions --graph example_graph --json`; it wins when they differ.

| Action | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `set_email` | who: ref stf:Employee, value: string | Set email of an employee. |
| `set_grade` | who: ref stf:Employee, value: enum stf:PayGrade | Set pay_grade of an employee. |
| `set_phone` | who: ref stf:Employee, value: string | Set phone of an employee. |
| `set_phone_badged` | who: ref stf:Employee, value: string | Set phone of an employee. |

Dry run first: `graph do <action> --param <name>=<value> --graph example_graph --dry-run`, read what it will change, then run it without `--dry-run`; `graph describe action <action> --graph example_graph` gives its preconditions and when to use it.
